owner_request.request: Include research on all 1,079 funds in the selected universe, not only the ones with a clean peer group.

scope: funds that Phase 4.5 gives no projection: IDIOSYNCRATIC (no close reference), SPECIALIZED_LEVERAGED, SPECIALIZED_INVERSE, and funds excluded as MOVES_FAR_MORE_THAN_ITS_REFERENCE; plus readings for funds without a ranking call

own_history_outlook.rule: the fund's own monthly log returns across all of its history up to the month-end (at least 36 months): center = their mean, spread = the de-meaned returns resampled in 12-month blocks into 36-month paths (2,000 paths, fixed seed). Leveraged and inverse funds' own history includes their decay, so no separate adjustment is made.
own_history_outlook.test: the Phase 4.5 walk-forward: every December start from 2005 whose 36 months have ended, each fund in its category at that start; share of realized 36-month annualized returns inside the 10th-90th band, by category
own_history_outlook.labels: every own-history outlook is labelled OWN_HISTORY with its category's status and measured coverage; growth is never compared across funds on it

loose_peer_readings.IDIOSYNCRATIC: cost percentile among the funds of the peer group of its nearest reference fund, marked LOOSE_PEERS with the correlation; a reading, not a ranking call
loose_peer_readings.SPECIALIZED_LEVERAGED: cost percentile among the other leveraged funds; a reading, not a call
loose_peer_readings.SPECIALIZED_INVERSE: cost percentile among the other inverse funds; a reading, not a call
loose_peer_readings.timing: idiosyncratic funds show the timing reading of their nearest reference's family, marked loose; leveraged and inverse funds get none (their test families do not describe them)

unchanged: BUY / ACCUMULATE / HOLD / AVOID calls stay limited to proper peer groups, where the 36-month cost evidence was measured
